answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the cipher forfeiture shows up in the tide totals with the trellis audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 27% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 88 aliases after a single epoch as a result destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
